hard_constraints_summary: Must include young programmer, robot family, endangered birds, natural pollination, and pest control in a world dependent on nature. Must avoid romance, time travel, magic, and fantasy creatures.
soft_constraints_summary: Desired tone is inspirational, focusing on the young programmer's innovative solution to save endangered birds and their ecological roles.
brief: In a world where outliving a robot family is common, a young programmer discovers a groundbreaking method to predict and prevent the Convenient Death of migratory birds, saving endangered species and their vital ecological roles in a world increasingly dependent on natural pollination and pest control.
